question: Why can glass be recycled almost forever?
answer: Glass does not degrade when it melts, so a kilogram of waste glass becomes a kilogram of new glass. That makes the yield almost 100%, and the loop can repeat round after round. The page lets the reader drag to see how much is left after each melt.
move: Melting doesn't wear glass out, so the loop barely loses anything.
